**What should come out?**

<!-- Name the feature, menu item, panel, setting or behaviour. -->

**Why?**

<!-- Anything at all is a valid reason. Some examples:
     - I have never used it.
     - It gets in my way while writing.
     - It clutters a menu I use constantly.
     - Another feature already covers this.
     - It surprised me and I could not tell what it did. -->

**Would anything break for you if it disappeared tomorrow?**

<!-- An honest "maybe, I'd miss X about it" is useful. So is "no, nothing." -->

Thanks for this. Cutting things is how the editor stays fast and stays out of
the way, and it is much harder to notice what should go than what is missing.
